name: Summer Friends
description_short: A general day camp on the Friends Academy campus in North Dartmouth, MA. Campers are grouped by grade and do crafts, sports, music, water play, science and nature activities, with a weekly theme and either a field trip or a guest presentation. There is a preschool program (Little Friends, ages 3-4) and a three-week Counselor in Training program for ages 14-16.

sessions.name: Week 2: Blast Off! (no camp Fri July 3)

source.title: Summer Friends - Day Camps for Ages 3-16 in Dartmouth, MA - Friends Academy

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season (June 22 to August 14, 2026), which has already ended as of 2026-10-13. 2027 dates, themes and prices are not posted yet.
No prices are shown on this page.
Grades 6-8 can only attend Summer Friends in the afternoon (12-3), after a morning Specialty or SBP camp. Kindergarten through Grade 5 can attend a full day (9-3) or afternoons only.

Little Friends (ages 3-4) is a separate preschool program, with full-day (9-3) or morning (9-12) options and no field trips. CIT (ages 14-16) is a three-week session that runs alongside the regular weeks.
